text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- 4 missing as U.S. Navy plane disappears at sea during training with Israel Navy
- Police question ministers Meridor, Hanegbi, Deri and businessman Appel in corruption case
- Meridor, Frenkel decide to avoid changes in exchange rate system
- Bank of Israel did not interfere in foreign exchange commerce for first time since early January
- Sources in Prime Minister's office: there is interest in buying Koor and Klal if they are separated from Bank Hapoalim
